requirements.text: Working with various Embedded Software Ecosystem partners to assist their development and porting of Real-Time Operating Systems and Hypervisors to AMD silicon including both AMD-x86 (Ryzen & Epyc) and ARM based ASoC’s (ARM Cortex A78, R52).
A successful candidate will be able to build and run AMD Targeted Reference Designs on both Linux and Bare Metal and then demonstrate those designs to Ecosystem Partners.

This will include running AMD Tools such as Vivado and Vitis AI to build firmware for a TRD, providing the necessary boot artifacts to partners along with example design sources and build scripts for Linux and Bare Metal.
The ability to explain the system complexities of a given TRD to ecosystem partners and answer their porting questions is a must.
Knowledge of AMD FPGA’s, various IP’s such as the VCU and ISP, low level drivers for graphics (G78) and audio, and some experience with real-time operating systems is required.
